subject.title: fix: enforce sandbox tool policy for loopback tools [AI]

question: Should this sandbox-policy enforcement for gateway loopback/MCP tools land now with the posted production-adapter proof, or wait for a full external harness proof or adjacent resolver merge order?
rationale: The patch matches the documented sandbox policy boundary and now has useful proof, but it intentionally changes which tools existing sandboxed loopback sessions can see and the PR carries a protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Accept production-adapter proof
options.body: Land after maintainer confirmation that sandboxed loopback/MCP sessions should fail closed under `tools.sandbox.tools.*` and ordinary merge checks are green.

options.title: Require full harness proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted external coding-agent CLI/container loopback run before merge if production-adapter JSON-RPC proof is not enough for this boundary.

options.title: Wait for adjacent resolver work
options.body: Pause until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102003 is resolved, then rebase and verify sandbox filtering plus plugin tool visibility together.

recommendation.title: Accept production-adapter proof
recommendation.body: Land after maintainer confirmation that sandboxed loopback/MCP sessions should fail closed under `tools.sandbox.tools.*` and ordinary merge checks are green.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the recent gateway resolver baseline and is the clearest owner signal for accepting the compatibility/security-boundary merge choice.
